rules.statement: A co-owner can lawfully use the property for its intended purpose, but cannot appropriate more than their share of profits.
rules.supporting_quote: "The next point for consideration is the attitude assumed by the plaintiffs towards this working of the mill. In giving evidence the first plaintiff states that after the period of the lease P 2, in favour of his father had expired he brought the Vidane Arachchi and gave over possession to the other co-owners. Moreover that he told the other co-owners to give him another lease and if not, asked them to take over the entire mill and premises on a lease."
